findings.problem: Raising from async TERM/INT can interrupt a successful Popen before child or pgid registration. Cleanup then returns for child=None or cannot address the owned group for pgid=None. A further signal can interrupt cleanup itself.
findings.required_change: Flag-only catchable-signal handler. Check flag at ordinary prelaunch/loop/pre-completion guards; never raise inside async handler. Retain flags during bounded cleanup and publish confirmed or uncertain absence without a PASS on pending signal.

findings.problem: Fresh resources checks existing files only. Unbounded state and temporary-image publication can cross growth or disk caps before the post-check; initial RUNNING publication also precedes admission.
findings.required_change: Bound encoded state bytes and reserve peak new publication bytes against unchanged growth/disk floors before every owned publication, including retained temporary/failure images. Make initial admission precede publication; postchecks and failed/uncertain status remain mandatory.
